question: Audit my node with one H100 and Kubernetes for image attribute augmentation. Do not change anything yet.
expected_behavior: Selects environment setup from the natural-language request without requiring a skill name.
Asks for the kubeconfig path when KUBECONFIG is unset, rather than assuming one.
Runs the read-only Kubernetes audit first.
Treats the host vendor as a provider-neutral Kubernetes host.
Recommends external model endpoints for one H100.
Does not mutate the cluster.

question: Check the H100 cluster reachable as gpu-box through SSH; it uses k3s kubectl.
expected_behavior: Uses SSH configuration rather than requesting private key contents.
Uses --kubectl-command k3s kubectl.
Returns compute and controller readiness separately.

question: Set up whatever my remote GPU cluster needs for SDG Workflow.
expected_behavior: Audits before mutation.
Explains exact namespace, Secret, and optional PVC changes.
Lists the commands it will run and waits for user approval before executing any of them.
Does not run make install sdg-controller before presenting the plan.

question: Deploy the SDG controller on my cluster. I have secrets.env filled in and my kubeconfig at /home/me/kubeconfig.yaml.
expected_behavior: Uses the kubeconfig path the user gave rather than a repository-relative default.
Runs make setup to validate secrets and generate the Helm values.
Runs make install sdg-controller (not bare make install).
Does not attempt to build or push Docker images.
Confirms with the user before executing destructive install steps.
Notes that DAGs are synced from S3 and make sync-dag should be run after code changes.

question: My cluster does not have an NFS StorageClass yet. How do I install one?
expected_behavior: Instructs the user to run make install nfs.
Explains the NFS_NODE_HOSTNAME and NFS_SERVER Makefile variables.
Does not reference microk8s-hostpath.

question: I changed a DAG file. How do I update Airflow without reinstalling the chart?
expected_behavior: Instructs the user to run make sync-dag.
Explains that the dag-synchronizer pulls from S3 on a configurable interval.
Does not recommend make install sdg-controller for a simple DAG update.

question: What secrets do I need before running make setup?
expected_behavior: Lists NGC_API_KEY, HF_TOKEN, and AWS S3 credentials (bucket, region, key ID, secret).
Does not mention GITLAB_TOKEN.
References secrets.env and secrets.env.example.
Does not describe tool installation as part of make setup.

question: My kubeconfig has server: https://127.0.0.1:6443. Will make setup work?
expected_behavior: Warns that 127.0.0.1 is not reachable from Airflow controller pods.
Instructs the user to replace it with the node's cluster-reachable IP.
Does not proceed with make setup until the server address is corrected.

question: I have one H100. Should I use internal or external services?
expected_behavior: Recommends external model endpoints because internal mode requires at least four GPUs.
Explains that the augmentation worker and controller can still run on the one-GPU cluster.
Does not require a separate controller cluster.

question: I have an H100 machine with Docker but no Kubernetes. Can I run SDG Workflow?
expected_behavior: Rejects Docker-only as a supported backend.
Instructs the user to install an appropriate Kubernetes distribution first.
Does not claim to install Kubernetes automatically.
